phases.objective: Register the governed Work Map Recovery dispatcher by deferring report-directory initialization until after GitHub allocates the runner, without weakening exact-head authorization, marker consumption, or mutation boundaries.

e2e_journeys.actor: Repository maintainer and governed Work Map Recovery dispatcher
e2e_journeys.entrypoint: Workflow dispatch, pull-request-target transition, or authorized issue comment
e2e_journeys.terminal_outcome: The workflow is registrable, initializes REPORT_DIR from RUNNER_TEMP after runner allocation, validates an exact current pull-request head, consumes one authorization marker, and delegates only to the sole governed Work Map writer.
steps: Allocate the Ubuntu runner before resolving a temporary report path.
Initialize REPORT_DIR from RUNNER_TEMP and publish it through GITHUB_ENV.
Resolve the open same-repository pull request and require behind_by=0.
Consume the one-time Work Map authorization marker.
Enable and dispatch only the governed writer and integration workflows.
Publish bounded no-secret recovery evidence without protected-branch mutation or force push.
assertions: Report initialization precedes exact target resolution.
The /recover-work-maps command and exact authorization marker remain required.
Stale pull-request heads fail closed before delegation.
Direct repository mutation, protected-branch mutation, force push, and secret inclusion remain false.

phases.objective: Expose registration and delegated-run identity through canonical workflow evidence.
Prove fail-closed behavior across disabled writer workflows, stale heads, and repeated authorization attempts.
